'''The Shattered Rock''', also known simply as '''The Rock''', was an [[asteroid base]]. The asteroid had been impacted, causing large caverns inside the rock to be accessible. It was in the process of being fitted out by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] to be used as a base after being discovered by [[Mils Gessak]], leader of [[Recon Mission D812]]. A single pressurized chamber served as the starting point for the outpost. The Alliance contracted [[Outlaw tech/Legends|outlaw tech]] [[Arago Tanca]] to build the outpost.<ref name="HS">''[[Hideouts & Strongholds]]''</ref>
